# Buttermilk biscuit tweaks

- Try cake flour blend
- Resting dough 20 min cold improves layers
- Linda swears by the same recipe, no changes - keep her copy on the fridge

# Pot roast variations

- Carrots and pearl onions, no celery for Daniel
- Try anchovy paste next time (1 tsp)
- Mashed potatoes: half-milk, half-buttermilk

# Herb bed - summer rotation

- Basil thriving
- Mint corner-only or it takes over
- Replace thyme; the new one wilted in week 2

# Reading queue

- Demon Copperhead - Kingsolver (re-read)
- Hometown by Tracy Kidder
- The Witch Elm - Tana French

# Anne Tyler thread

Why her families feel like the kind I read for. Saint Maybe, Ladder of Years.
